higher_dimensions.name: Higher Dimensions: Beyond 3D
higher_dimensions.truth: We are 3D creatures projecting 4D shadows. The tesseract rotates through dimensions we cannot directly perceive.
higher_dimensions.qfep_connection: Higher-dimensional geometry extends F (order) into spaces we cannot inhabit. Pure structure, revealed through projection—the Platonic forms casting shadows into our world.
higher_dimensions.description: Explore geometry beyond three dimensions. Tesseracts, penteracts, 16-cells—polytopes that exist in 4D and 5D space, visualized through projection into 3D. Walk through the nets, see rotations through the fourth dimension.
learning_objectives: Projection: how higher-D casts shadows into lower-D
